name: omitly-leak-check
description: Local, offline check for exposed or recoverable sensitive content in PDFs, plus verification of a redacted PDF. Diagnosis only — nothing is uploaded, nothing is redacted.
long_description: Omitly Redaction Leak Check runs entirely on your machine: it re-extracts the text layer of a PDF (including text hidden under black-box redaction marks, superseded incremental-update revisions, metadata, and form fields) and reports anything that looks like PII — emails, SSNs, phone numbers, card numbers, and Australian identifiers (TFN/ABN/ACN/Medicare/CRN/IHI/BSB). This is a diagnosis-only tool: it never redacts a file and never issues a certificate. All four tools are free with no usage limit; find_sensitive_regions and check_redaction results carry a sentence saying the tool removes nothing and is not a removal certificate. Made by Omitly: https://omitly.app

allowed_dir.title: Folder Omitly can scan
allowed_dir.description: The four diagnosis tools (check_redaction, find_sensitive_regions, locate_text, verify_redaction) can only read PDFs under this folder — nothing else on your machine is accessible to them. Pick the folder containing the documents you want checked.

tools.name: check_redaction
tools.description: Audit an already-redacted PDF on-device and report whether sensitive text still survives underneath the redaction marks, in superseded revisions, metadata, or form fields. Diagnosis only — never redacts, never issues a certificate. Also gives a check verdict (Safe to Send, Needs Review or Cannot Verify) from the same presented-document check the Omitly desktop app runs — a verdict about the check and what it covered, never a statement that the document is safe. No usage limit; results carry a sentence saying the check removes nothing.

tools.name: find_sensitive_regions
tools.description: Scan a local PDF on-device for candidate PII regions (email/SSN/phone/card plus Australian TFN/ABN/ACN/Medicare/CRN/IHI/BSB) with page and coordinates. Diagnosis only — does not redact. No usage limit; results carry a sentence saying the scan removes nothing.

tools.name: locate_text
tools.description: Locate literal strings (names, addresses, account references) in a local PDF on-device and return their page and coordinates. Diagnosis only — does not redact.

tools.name: verify_redaction
tools.description: Re-scan an already-redacted PDF on-device and report whether anything recoverable remains. Works offline; makes no vendor-trust claim beyond what it re-scans.
